products.name: Television News Channels
products.description: Production and distribution of 24/7 news and informational programming through linear cable, satellite, and OTT streaming platforms, including Newsmax, Newsmax2 (FAST channel), and World at War. Content is delivered via traditional pay TV, digital streaming, and international licensing.

products.name: Digital News and Content Platform
products.description: Operation of Newsmax.com and affiliated websites and apps, offering live and on-demand streaming, news articles, and digital content to millions of monthly visitors. Revenue is generated through online advertising, paid content placements, and digital subscriptions.

products.name: Streaming Subscription Service (Newsmax+)
products.description: Direct-to-consumer streaming service offering access to Newsmax, Newsmax2, World at War, and original documentaries and specials via apps on TV, phone, and tablet. Delivered digitally with recurring subscription revenue.

products.name: Radio and Podcast Programming
products.description: Production and syndication of radio shows and podcasts featuring news, commentary, and cultural discussion, distributed nationally via broadcast radio and major audio platforms. Revenue is generated through advertising and sponsorships.

products.name: Print and Digital Publications (Magazines and Newsletters)
products.description: Publishing and distribution of Newsmax Magazine, specialized health and financial newsletters, and online membership programs, offered via paid subscriptions in print and digital formats. Content is produced in-house and distributed to a large subscriber base.

products.name: Book Publishing (Humanix Publishing)
products.description: Publishing of print, audio, and e-books on topics such as politics, health, personal finance, history, and current affairs. Books are sold directly and used as premiums for subscription offers. Production is managed in-house and distributed through various channels.

products.name: Nutraceuticals and Dietary Supplements (Medix Select)
products.description: Development and online sale of 22 proprietary nutraceutical products formulated by medical professionals, manufactured at third-party FDA-registered facilities, and marketed primarily via recurring subscription programs to the core demographic.

products.name: Advertising Sales (Broadcast, Digital, Print, Audio)
products.description: Sales of advertising placements across television, digital platforms, email, SMS, print publications, radio, and podcasts. Advertising inventory is sold to third-party marketers and agencies, leveraging Newsmax’s audience reach across all media.

products.name: Media Buying and Strategy Services (ROI Media Strategies)
products.description: Provision of media buying and marketing strategy services to third-party companies and agencies, assisting clients in marketing their offerings across email, broadcast, podcasts, digital, and print channels.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services (Crown Atlantic Insurance)
products.description: Licensed insurance agency offering life insurance and retirement solutions, with plans to market annuities, life insurance, and other insurance products across Newsmax’s platforms. Services are delivered through licensed agents in all 50 states and D.C.

products.name: Pre-Owned Yacht and Boat Sales
products.description: The company buys and sells a wide range of pre-owned yachts and boats, including sportfish, center consoles, motor yachts, and high-performance boats, through physical locations and digital platforms. This involves physical acquisition, inspection, and resale of vessels to retail and wholesale customers.

products.name: New Boat Sales
products.description: OTH sells new boats from premier brands through dealership partnerships, expanding its inventory and serving customers seeking the latest models. This requires dealership agreements, inventory management, and in-person or online sales.

products.name: Yacht Brokerage Services
products.description: The company provides brokerage services for high-end and luxury yachts, connecting buyers and sellers and facilitating premium transactions through experienced brokers and a dedicated platform. This is a service-based business requiring specialized human expertise and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Boat and Yacht Financing Solutions
products.description: Through Azure Funding, OTH offers a range of financing options for recreational boat buyers and industry partners, including traditional loans, short-term lending, and alternative financing. This is a regulated financial service involving partnerships with banks and in-house loan processing.

products.name: Instant Boat Purchase Platform (WeBuyBoats.com)
products.description: OTH operates WeBuyBoats.com, an online platform that provides instant cash offers to boat owners, enabling quick liquidation of boats using proprietary valuation tools and market data. This is a digital service requiring technology infrastructure and market analytics.

products.name: Marine Servicing and Maintenance
products.description: Through OTH Yacht Services, the company offers comprehensive marine servicing, including routine maintenance, repairs, detailing, and mechanical inspections, delivered at owned service centers. This is a labor-intensive, in-person service requiring skilled technicians and physical facilities.

products.name: Marine Asset Recovery and Repossession
products.description: Via Marine Asset Recovery, OTH provides repossession and asset recovery services for financial institutions, reclaiming and reselling marine assets, often reintegrating them into its sales inventory. This involves field operations, legal compliance, and resale logistics.

products.name: Boat and Yacht Warranties
products.description: OTH is developing a warranty sales program to offer buyers additional coverage against unexpected repair costs, enhancing after-sale support. This is a financial product sold alongside boat purchases, requiring underwriting and customer service infrastructure.

products.name: Marina Operations and Storage Services
products.description: The company is expanding into marina ownership and operations, providing boat storage, docking, and related services at acquired facilities. This involves real estate acquisition, facility management, and service delivery to boat owners.

products.name: CDH6-Targeted Antibody-Drug Conjugate (SIM0505)
products.description: A clinical-stage antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) targeting CDH6, produced using monoclonal antibody technology conjugated to a proprietary topoisomerase 1 inhibitor payload. Manufactured via biopharmaceutical processes and delivered as an injectable therapy for solid tumors, especially gynecological cancers.

products.name: B7-H4-Targeted Antibody-Drug Conjugate (LNCB74)
products.description: A clinical-stage antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) targeting B7-H4, produced using monoclonal antibody technology and a proprietary tubulin inhibitor payload (MMAE). Manufactured via biopharmaceutical processes and delivered as an injectable therapy for cancers with high B7-H4 expression, including breast, ovarian, and endometrial cancers.

products.name: LAIR-2 Fusion Protein (NC410)
products.description: A clinical-stage fusion protein therapy designed to block immune suppression in tumors by targeting the LAIR-1 pathway. Produced using recombinant protein technology and delivered as an injectable biologic for oncology indications.

products.name: LAIR-1 Antibody Therapy (NC525)
products.description: A clinical-stage monoclonal antibody therapy selectively targeting LAIR-1 on acute myeloid leukemia (AML) blast cells and leukemic stem cells. Produced via biopharmaceutical manufacturing and delivered as an injectable biologic for hematologic cancers.

products.name: ApoE4 Antibody Therapy for Alzheimer’s Disease (NC181)
products.description: A preclinical-stage humanized monoclonal antibody targeting ApoE4 for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease. Produced using recombinant antibody technology and intended for delivery as an injectable biologic.

products.name: Siglec-15 Antibody Therapy for Osteogenesis Imperfecta (NC605)
products.description: A preclinical-stage monoclonal antibody targeting Siglec-15 for the treatment of osteogenesis imperfecta and potentially other bone diseases. Produced using recombinant antibody technology and intended for delivery as an injectable biologic.

products.name: Factual Streaming Subscription Service
products.description: A digital subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) service offering on-demand access to a library of factual video and audio programming, delivered via proprietary apps and third-party platforms to consumers and enterprises. Content is produced, co-produced, commissioned, or licensed, and is available in multiple languages and high-definition formats.

products.name: Content Licensing
products.description: Licensing of factual video and audio content, including curated datasets, to entertainment media companies and technology firms for traditional media use and for training AI models. Content is monetized through direct licensing deals, including non-monetary barter transactions, and pre-production sales of selected rights.

products.name: Bundled Distribution for Affiliates
products.description: Provision of bundled factual content, including linear channels and on-demand libraries, to MVPDs, vMVPDs, and broadband/wireless companies for inclusion in their subscription packages, delivered under multi-year agreements with fixed or per-subscriber fees.

products.name: Advertising and Sponsorship Services
products.description: Development and sale of integrated digital brand partnerships, advertising spots, and sponsorships within video and audio content, including AVOD and FAST channels, as well as branded content on platforms like YouTube and digital display ads.

products.name: Educational Courses and Lectures (Curiosity University)
products.description: A digital offering of video and audio courses and lectures on factual topics, acquired through One Day University and Learn25, and delivered as standalone products or bundled with other services to consumers and business customers.

products.name: PagerDuty Operations Cloud Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-hosted digital operations management platform that integrates incident management, AIOps, automation, customer service operations, and AI-powered capabilities. Delivered as SaaS, it orchestrates real-time detection, response, and remediation of incidents across enterprise technology stacks using AI, automation, and integrations with over 700 third-party tools.

products.name: Incident Management
products.description: A cloud-based solution for real-time incident detection, response, and resolution, leveraging AI for noise reduction, automated response, and end-to-end incident lifecycle management. Delivered via web, mobile, and integrations, it enables teams to resolve issues quickly and proactively prevent future incidents.

products.name: AIOps
products.description: A SaaS product applying machine learning to correlate, enrich, and triage digital events at scale, reducing noise and automating incident identification and response. Integrates with diverse monitoring and observability tools to provide actionable insights and dynamic routing.

products.name: Automation
products.description: A cloud-based automation platform for designing and executing automated workflows across departments, technologies, and networks. Enables self-service operations, speeds up incident resolution, and reduces operational costs and risks through centralized orchestration and secure delegation.

products.name: Customer Service Operations (CSOps)
products.description: A SaaS solution that orchestrates and automates responses to customer-impacting issues, integrating with popular case management platforms to provide real-time status, proactive communication, and escalation during incidents.

products.name: PagerDuty Advance (AI Capabilities and Agents)
products.description: A suite of generative AI features and domain-specific agents (e.g., SRE Agent) embedded in the platform, providing context synthesis, incident summarization, recommendations, and automated action execution. Delivered as part of the Operations Cloud, these agents act as always-on copilots for operational tasks.

products.name: Professional Services and Training
products.description: Paid implementation, workflow optimization, best-practice guidance, and training services to help customers onboard, optimize, and certify on PagerDuty products. Delivered through consulting engagements and instructor-led or self-paced programs.

products.name: Ateganosine (THIO) Telomere-Targeting Cancer Therapeutics
products.description: Ateganosine (THIO) is a synthetically-modified small molecule nucleoside developed as a telomere-targeting agent for cancer therapy. It is administered as a monotherapy or in sequential combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors (such as cemiplimab, tislelizumab, or atezolizumab) to treat various cancers, including non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), colorectal cancer (CRC), small cell lung cancer (SCLC), and other solid tumors. The product is manufactured through chemical synthesis and delivered via clinical administration, requiring regulated infrastructure and clinical trial validation.

products.name: Second-Generation Telomere-Targeting Small Molecule Cancer Therapeutics
products.description: A pipeline of next-generation small molecule telomere-modifying agents, compositionally distinct from ateganosine, designed to improve specificity and anticancer activity. These are in preclinical and early clinical development, intended for use across multiple cancer types. The products are developed through proprietary chemical synthesis and require preclinical and clinical testing for regulatory approval.

products.name: Consulting & Engineering Services
products.description: Provides consulting, software engineering, and custom and enterprise application solutions, including AI and data analytics, to help clients modernize processes and drive digital transformation. Delivered through a combination of human expertise and technology, tailored to various industries.

products.name: Insurance Software and Business Process Services
products.description: Delivers software and business process outsourcing services for insurance providers, including Life and Wealth, Property & Casualty, and Reinsurance, as well as support for bank cards, payment, and lending operations. Solutions involve both proprietary software and managed services, often integrating advanced AI and digital technologies.

products.name: Cloud Infrastructure, IT Outsourcing & Security Services
products.description: Designs, implements, manages, and optimizes clients’ IT infrastructure across hybrid environments (data centers, public cloud, mainframes, networks), including strategic planning, migration, and ongoing operations. Integrates security and compliance, providing 24/7 protection and regulatory expertise through a global team and Security Operations Centers.

products.name: Modern Workplace Services
products.description: Provides managed workplace solutions including device management, helpdesk support, and AI-powered digital workplace platforms to enhance employee productivity and experience. Services are delivered remotely and on-site, focusing on automation, security, and seamless collaboration.

products.name: Subsea Robotics Services and Products
products.description: Provision of work-class remotely operated vehicles (ROVs), ROV tooling, and autonomous underwater vehicles for offshore energy operations, including drill support, subsea hardware installation, inspection, maintenance, repair, and survey services. These are physically manufactured and operated with specialized personnel and vessels.

products.name: Manufactured Subsea and Industrial Products
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of subsea umbilicals, production control equipment, clamp connectors, pipeline connector and repair systems, subsea and topside control valves, and autonomous mobile robotic technology for offshore and industrial markets. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to customers globally.

products.name: Integrated Offshore Projects and Vessel-Based Services
products.description: Comprehensive subsea project services including subsea installation and intervention, riserless light well intervention, IMR (inspection, maintenance, repair), diving, decommissioning, project management, and vessel-based operations using owned and chartered deepwater vessels equipped with ROVs.

products.name: Asset Integrity Management and Digital Solutions
products.description: Asset integrity management, corrosion management, inspection, and nondestructive testing services for onshore and offshore facilities, as well as software, digital, and connectivity solutions for asset management and regulatory compliance. Services are delivered through a combination of in-person engineering, digital platforms, and remote inspection technologies.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Engineering and Manufacturing Services
products.description: Engineering, prototype design, manufacturing, and maintenance services for defense and space exploration, primarily for U.S. government agencies such as the Department of Defense and NASA. These services involve custom engineering, risk mitigation, and production of specialized equipment for harsh environments.

products.name: In Vivo Gene Editing Therapies
products.description: Therapeutic products developed using the proprietary ARCUS platform to edit genes directly within the body (in vivo), targeting specific diseases such as chronic hepatitis B (PBGENE-HBV), Duchenne muscular dystrophy (PBGENE-DMD), and mitochondrial diseases (PBGENE-3243). These therapies are manufactured using advanced biotechnology processes and delivered via viral vectors or lipid nanoparticles, requiring regulated infrastructure and clinical development.

products.name: Partnered In Vivo Gene Editing Programs
products.description: Gene editing therapies developed in collaboration with external partners (e.g., iECURE), leveraging the ARCUS platform for specific indications such as ornithine transcarbamylase (OTC) deficiency. These are co-developed and may be commercialized by partners, involving technology transfer and joint clinical development.

products.name: Out-Licensed Cell Therapy and Immunotherapy Programs
products.description: Cell therapy and immunotherapy product candidates (including allogeneic CAR T therapies) developed using ARCUS and licensed to third parties (e.g., TG Therapeutics, Imugene) for further development and commercialization in indications such as autoimmune diseases and oncology. These involve manufacturing genetically modified cells and are delivered as regulated biologic products.

products.name: ARCUS Genome Editing Platform Licensing
products.description: Non-exclusive licensing of the proprietary ARCUS genome editing platform and foundational patents to third parties (e.g., Caribou Biosciences) for use in developing their own gene or cell therapy products. This is a technology licensing business line, generating revenue through upfront payments, milestones, and royalties.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of business loans including commercial and industrial loans, commercial real estate loans, construction and development loans, and SBA lending, primarily to small-to-midsized businesses. These loans are originated and serviced by experienced bankers and require in-depth underwriting and risk management.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers various loans to individuals, including residential real estate loans, home equity loans, installment loans, and personal lines of credit. These are underwritten based on the borrower's financial condition and may be secured or unsecured.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a full suite of deposit products such as checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit to both businesses and consumers. Delivery is through physical branches, online, and mobile banking platforms.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: Delivers treasury management, cash management, and related services such as ACH, wire transfers, lock box, vault services, and sweep accounts to business customers. These services are supported by technology and specialized personnel.

products.name: Wealth Management and Private Banking
products.description: Provides wealth management, fiduciary, and private banking services to high net worth individuals and businesses, including financial planning, retirement services, investment management, and access to a range of financial products. Delivered by a team of advisors and offered at all banking centers.

products.name: Card Services
products.description: Issues and manages debit and credit card products for both consumer and business customers, enabling electronic payments and access to funds.

products.name: Merchant Services
products.description: Provides merchant processing solutions to business customers, enabling them to accept electronic payments from their customers. Includes payment processing and related support.

products.name: Correspondent Banking Services
products.description: Offers correspondent banking services to other financial institutions, including receivables factoring and specialized banking solutions through its Financial Institutions Group.

products.name: PowerTrack Software Suite
products.description: An integrated, AI-enabled software platform for monitoring, controlling, and optimizing solar, storage, and hybrid energy assets. Delivered as a digital, hardware-agnostic solution, it provides analytics, SCADA, power plant control, logging, and optimization capabilities for commercial and utility-scale customers.

products.name: Edge Hardware Solutions
products.description: OEM-agnostic edge devices that connect customers’ solar and storage assets to the PowerTrack software, enabling unified asset monitoring and control. These are physical hardware products installed at customer sites to facilitate data integration and asset management.

products.name: Managed Services for Energy Storage and Hybrid Systems
products.description: Full lifecycle managed services covering the design, procurement, commissioning, operation, and optimization of energy storage and hybrid systems, enabled by PowerTrack Optimizer software. Delivered through a combination of digital tools and in-person expertise.

products.name: Professional Services for Solar and Storage Projects
products.description: A comprehensive suite of professional services supporting solar and storage projects through every stage of the project lifecycle, including advisory, engineering, procurement, integration, and performance optimization. Delivered by in-house experts to assist customers in navigating complex clean energy portfolios.

products.name: Project Services for Solution Design and Commissioning
products.description: Project-based services assisting customers with the design and commissioning of solar, storage, and hybrid energy solutions. These services are delivered by technical teams and support the deployment and integration of the company’s software and hardware products.

products.name: Scheduled Air Transportation
products.description: Nonstop, limited-frequency passenger flights between under-served U.S. cities and popular leisure destinations, operated using a fleet of Boeing 737 and Airbus A320 series aircraft. Service is provided directly to customers via the company's website and airport counters.

products.name: Ancillary Air-Related Products and Services
products.description: Optional, unbundled services and products sold alongside air transportation, including larger seats, baggage fees, advance seat assignments, travel protection, change fees, call center purchases, priority boarding, food and beverage sales, and bundled ancillary packages. Delivered digitally or in-person during the travel experience.

products.name: Third Party Travel Products and Services
products.description: Resale of third party travel products such as hotel rooms, rental cars, and travel insurance, offered through partnerships and integrated into the company's direct booking platform. These are marketed to airline customers as add-ons to air travel.

products.name: Fixed Fee Contract Air Transportation and Charter Services
products.description: Air transportation provided under fixed fee agreements and charter contracts, including year-round and ad hoc charter flights for organizations or groups. Service is delivered using the company's aircraft and crew, tailored to client requirements.

products.name: Co-Brand Credit Card and Loyalty Programs
products.description: A co-branded credit card and a non-card loyalty program offering travel rewards, promotions, and perks such as priority boarding and complimentary drinks. These programs are delivered digitally and incentivize repeat purchases of air and ancillary products.

products.name: C3 Agentic AI Platform
products.description: A comprehensive, end-to-end platform-as-a-service for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications at scale. Delivered as software that can be run on public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, or on-premises infrastructure, it provides model-driven architecture, data integration, AI/ML services, security, and low-code/no-code tools for rapid application development.

products.name: C3 AI Applications
products.description: A portfolio of pre-built, extensible, industry-specific and application-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that address high-value use cases such as asset performance, supply chain, defense, government, sustainability, CRM, financial services, and healthcare. Delivered as cloud-based software, these applications can be rapidly installed, customized, and deployed.

products.name: C3 Generative AI
products.description: A suite of generative AI solutions and applications leveraging large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and advanced reasoning to retrieve data, analyze information, surface insights, and orchestrate workflows for enterprise use cases. Available as a standalone product or integrated with other C3 AI offerings, it is delivered as cloud-based software and can be deployed on customer data and systems.

products.name: Professional Services (Implementation, Consulting, Training)
products.description: Paid services including engineering, implementation, consulting, and training to help customers develop, deploy, and customize enterprise-scale AI applications. Delivered by C3 AI or partners, these services support successful adoption and integration of C3 AI software products.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Allbirds designs and manufactures lifestyle footwear for men and women using innovative, naturally derived materials such as merino wool, tree fibers, and sugarcane. Products are produced through a global supply chain and distributed via eCommerce, third-party retailers, and select physical stores.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: Allbirds offers a curated range of lifestyle apparel for men and women, including tees, sweats, socks, and underwear, crafted with natural and recycled materials for comfort and sustainability. Apparel is manufactured in the United States, China, Peru, and Mexico and distributed through digital and retail channels.

products.name: ZERUST Corrosion Prevention Solutions
products.description: A suite of proprietary rust and corrosion inhibiting products and services, including plastic and paper packaging, liquids, coatings, rust removers, cleaners, diffusers, and engineered solutions. These are manufactured using NTIC’s chemical formulations and delivered as physical products and technical consulting services to industrial customers for the protection of metal assets.

products.name: ZERUST Corrosion Prevention Solutions for Oil and Gas Industry
products.description: Specialized engineered corrosion inhibiting solutions and services tailored for the oil and gas industry, including products such as Flange Savers, Zif Tape, ReCAST-SSB solutions, and Zerion powders and gels. These solutions are delivered as both materials and field engineering services to protect critical oil and gas infrastructure from corrosion.

products.name: Natur-Tec Bio-based and Compostable Resin Compounds
products.description: Proprietary bio-based and certified compostable polymer resin compounds manufactured using NTIC’s patented technologies. These resin compounds are sold to plastics converters and brands for use in conventional plastic manufacturing processes to produce sustainable packaging and products.

products.name: Natur-Tec Finished Bioplastic Products
products.description: A range of finished biodegradable and compostable products, including trash bags, agricultural film, foodservice items, and consumer packaging, manufactured from Natur-Tec resin compounds and sold under the Natur-Bag brand. These are produced at NTIC and partner facilities and distributed to retail, commercial, and institutional customers.

products.name: Hydrafacial Systems and Treatments
products.description: A noninvasive hydradermabrasion treatment platform delivered via proprietary medical devices (Syndeo, Elite Tower, Allegro) that cleanse, extract, and hydrate skin using patented technology and proprietary consumables. Devices are manufactured in-house and sold to professional providers, who deliver treatments to end consumers.

products.name: Hydrafacial Consumables (Tips, Solutions, Serums, Boosters)
products.description: Single-use consumables including patented tips, proprietary solutions, chemical peels, and serums (including Boosters) used with Hydrafacial devices to deliver and personalize treatments. These are manufactured and sold on a recurring basis to providers for each treatment session.

products.name: SkinStylus Microneedling and Nano-Channeling Systems
products.description: A device-based platform (SkinStylus SteriLock Microsystem) for minimally invasive microneedling and non-invasive nano-channeling treatments, designed to stimulate collagen production and enhance absorption of topical products. Devices and accessories are sold to providers for use in treating scars and improving skin texture.

products.name: HydraScalp powered by Keravive
products.description: A scalp health treatment delivered via Hydrafacial devices, using the Keravive Peptide Solution and custom tips to cleanse, exfoliate, and hydrate the scalp, with an at-home spray for ongoing use. Designed to support the appearance of healthier, fuller-looking hair, sold to providers and consumers.

products.name: MyBeautyHealth Mobile Application
products.description: A digital platform and loyalty program that rewards consumers for treatments, provides personalized skin health plans, and connects users with local Hydrafacial providers. Delivered as a mobile app to consumers and as a value-add service to providers.

products.name: Homebuilding (Single-Family Homes)
products.description: Designs, builds, and sells single-family homes—including entry-level, move-up, active adult, and custom homes—across multiple U.S. markets. Homes are constructed using an asset-light lot acquisition strategy and delivered as either move-in-ready or customizable options.

products.name: Built-for-Rent Homes
products.description: Constructs and sells homes in bulk to third-party investors under built-for-rent contracts. These homes are delivered in communities specifically for rental purposes, with all sales to investors occurring at one point in time.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Provides mortgage financing solutions to homebuyers primarily through its wholly owned subsidiary, Jet HomeLoans. Services include conforming and non-conforming mortgage loans, with operations regulated at state and federal levels.

products.name: Title Insurance and Closing Services
products.description: Offers title insurance agency and underwriting services, as well as closing and escrow services for residential and commercial real estate transactions, through subsidiaries DF Title and Alliant Title. Services are delivered by licensed agents and attorneys in multiple states.

products.name: Homeowners Insurance and Adjacent Products
products.description: Provides homeowners insurance policies and related products to homebuyers, primarily through an in-house customer insurance agency targeting new-home construction. Policies are sourced from top-rated providers.

products.name: Fashion Apparel and Accessories Retail
products.description: Retail sale of a broad assortment of fashion apparel and accessories, including dressy, career, and casual sportswear, dresses, coats, shoes, lingerie, costume jewelry, handbags, men's wear, and children's clothing, through physical stores and e-commerce platforms. Merchandise is primarily private label, sourced from overseas manufacturers, and delivered via a centralized distribution center.

products.name: Private Label Credit Card Services
products.description: Provision of a proprietary credit card to customers for purchasing merchandise, including credit approval, finance charges, late fees, and a loyalty rewards program. The credit card is managed in-house and represents a small but meaningful portion of retail sales.

products.name: Layaway Plan Services
products.description: Offering a layaway program that allows customers to reserve merchandise by making periodic payments, with merchandise set aside until fully paid. The service includes administrative and restocking fees and is recognized as a distinct sales channel.

products.name: Online Marketplace for Authenticated Pre-Owned Luxury Goods
products.description: A digital platform offering a curated selection of authenticated, primarily pre-owned luxury goods from thousands of premium designers, sold via website and mobile app. All items are authenticated, photographed, priced, and fulfilled by the company.

products.name: Retail Stores for Authenticated Pre-Owned Luxury Goods
products.description: Physical retail locations, including neighborhood and flagship stores, selling a curated selection of authenticated, pre-owned luxury goods. Stores also serve as drop-off points for consignors and provide in-person shopping experiences.

products.name: Consignment Services for Luxury Goods
products.description: End-to-end consignment services for individuals and businesses, including at-home consultation and pickup, virtual consultations, drop-off at consignment offices or stores, and complimentary shipping. The company handles authentication, pricing, listing, and sale of items on behalf of consignors.

products.name: Direct Purchase and Trade-In Programs for Luxury Goods
products.description: Programs such as 'Get Paid Now' and trade-in options where the company directly purchases luxury goods from individuals or businesses, providing payment before resale. Items are evaluated, authenticated, and priced prior to purchase.

products.name: Retail Motor Fuel Sales
products.description: Sale of gasoline and diesel fuel to retail customers through a network of company-operated convenience stores. Fuel is sourced from multiple suppliers and delivered by truck to stores, with inventory turning daily. Requires physical infrastructure, supply chain management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Convenience Merchandise Sales
products.description: Sale of snacks, beverages, nicotine products, and non-food merchandise through company-operated convenience stores. Merchandise is primarily sourced from a wholesale grocer and sold in-store, requiring physical retail operations and inventory management.

products.name: Food and Beverage Offerings
products.description: Preparation and sale of fresh food and beverage items, including made-to-order and grab-and-go options, primarily at larger format QuickChek stores. Delivered through in-store kitchens and foodservice operations, requiring in-person labor and compliance with food safety regulations.

products.name: Wholesale Fuel Sales
products.description: Sale of motor fuel to unbranded wholesale customers via company-owned and third-party terminals and pipeline positions. Involves bulk fuel procurement, storage, and distribution logistics.

products.name: Tome Foundational Treatment
products.description: A once-weekly, at-home skin renewal treatment using 100% Spongilla lacustris powder (Bioneedle) and an activating solution, designed to exfoliate, renew, and improve overall skin texture and appearance. Manufactured from wild-harvested freshwater sponge, it is delivered as a powder and activator kit for direct-to-consumer and professional use.

products.name: Tome Clearing Treatment (OTC Acne System)
products.description: An over-the-counter acne treatment system combining weekly Bioneedle (Spongilla lacustris powder) applications with daily salicylic acid wipes, designed to treat mild to severe acne through exfoliation, enhanced delivery of actives, and anti-inflammatory effects. Sold as a kit for home use and through professionals.

products.name: Tome OTC Psoriasis Care System
products.description: A planned over-the-counter topical system for managing psoriasis symptoms, combining Bioneedle treatments to lift surface buildup and promote turnover with established OTC actives for symptomatic relief. Intended for home use and professional application.

products.name: Tome OTC Dandruff/Scalp Care System
products.description: A planned OTC shampoo or scalp treatment using Bioneedle technology to exfoliate the scalp, accelerate turnover, and enhance delivery of anti-dandruff actives. Designed for consumers with dandruff or scalp issues, available as a shampoo or pre-shampoo treatment.

products.name: Tome Cosmetic Skincare Products (Serums, Gels, Lotions)
products.description: A line of cosmetic skincare products incorporating Bioneedle technology into serums, gels, and lotions for skin renewal, brightening, anti-aging, and texture refinement. These products are designed for general skin improvement and cosmetic use, leveraging natural ingredients and science-backed formulations.

products.name: Tome Sensitive Skin/Polishing Treatment
products.description: A planned milder Bioneedle-based treatment for consumers with sensitive skin, designed to gently improve skin texture, brightness, and smoothness without aggressive procedures. Intended as a weekly at-home cosmetic routine for texture refinement.

products.name: Bioneedle Delivery System (BDS) for Professional Use
products.description: A topical delivery platform using Bioneedle (Spongilla lacustris powder) to create microchannels in the skin, enabling intradermal delivery of macromolecules such as botulinum toxin or dermal fillers for aesthetic and medical skin conditions. Marketed to dermatologists and aestheticians as a professional in-office treatment alternative to injections or microneedling devices.

products.name: Etsy Online Marketplace
products.description: A global two-sided digital marketplace connecting independent sellers with buyers seeking unique, handcrafted, vintage, and personalized goods. The platform is digital-only, does not hold inventory, and is accessed via web and mobile apps.

products.name: Depop Fashion Resale Marketplace
products.description: A digital marketplace focused on secondhand and circular fashion, enabling users to buy and sell pre-loved apparel and accessories. The platform is app-centric, does not hold inventory, and targets younger demographics.

products.name: Seller Services (Advertising, Payments, Shipping Labels)
products.description: A suite of optional, value-added digital services for sellers on Etsy and Depop, including on-site advertising, payments processing, and discounted shipping labels. These services are delivered digitally and integrated into the marketplace platforms.

products.name: Automotive Preventive Maintenance Services
products.description: Comprehensive vehicle maintenance services delivered through company-operated and franchised retail service centers, including oil changes, battery, bulb and wiper replacements, tire rotations, and other manufacturer-recommended maintenance. Services are performed by certified technicians using proprietary systems and are provided in a quick, stay-in-your-car format at physical retail locations.

products.name: Franchise and Express Care Platform Services
products.description: Franchising of Valvoline-branded service centers and support for independent operators through the Express Care platform, providing operational systems, branding, and supply arrangements to external franchisees and independent quick lube operators.

products.name: AlloStem™ (CELZ-201-DDT) Allogenic Cell Therapy
products.description: A scalable, off-the-shelf allogenic human perinatal tissue-derived cell therapy manufactured under GMP conditions, used for immune and endocrine disorders, lower back pain, and as a platform for other regenerative therapies. Delivered via minimally invasive procedures or infusion, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical infrastructure.

products.name: ImmCelz™ (CELZ-100) Personalized Immune Cell Therapy
products.description: A personalized therapy where a patient's own immune cells are extracted, reprogrammed or 'supercharged' ex vivo with proprietary cell-free factors, and re-injected to treat immune and regenerative disorders. Requires specialized cell processing and clinical delivery.

products.name: StemSpine® Autologous Stem Cell Therapy for Chronic Lower Back Pain
products.description: A same-day, outpatient procedure using a patient's own bone marrow-derived stem cells, harvested and injected into muscles near the spine to stimulate angiogenesis and disc regeneration for degenerative disc disease. Delivered in physician offices, exempt from FDA premarket review under Section 361.

products.name: CELZ-201 CREATE-1 Therapy for Type 1 Diabetes
products.description: A cell therapy using AlloStem™ allogenic perinatal tissue-derived cells, administered to patients with recent onset Type 1 Diabetes to modulate immune response and preserve pancreatic function. Delivered via infusion in clinical trial settings, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical oversight.

products.name: AlloStemSpine® Cell Therapy for Chronic Lower Back Pain
products.description: A minimally invasive, ultrasound-guided procedure delivering AlloStem™ allogenic perinatal tissue-derived cells to treat chronic lower back pain associated with degenerative disc disease. Requires clinical infrastructure and regulated cell manufacturing.

products.name: OvaStem™ Autologous Stem Cell Therapy for Premature Ovarian Failure
products.description: A same-day, outpatient procedure using a woman's own bone marrow-derived stem cells, harvested and injected into dysfunctional ovaries to restore fertility in cases of premature ovarian failure. Delivered in physician offices, exempt from FDA premarket review under Section 361.

products.name: CaverStem® Autologous Stem Cell Therapy for Erectile Dysfunction
products.description: A patented, clinically proven procedure using a man's own stem cells, harvested and injected to treat erectile dysfunction unresponsive to standard drugs. Delivered in clinical settings, exempt from FDA premarket review under Section 361.

products.name: FemCelz® Autologous Stem Cell Therapy for Female Sexual Dysfunction
products.description: A procedure using a woman's own stem cells, harvested and injected to improve genital sensitivity and dryness. Delivered in clinical settings, exempt from FDA premarket review under Section 361.

products.name: iPScelz™ Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell Platform and Derived Therapies
products.description: A platform for developing human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) lines and iPSC-derived cell therapies, including pancreatic islet cells for diabetes and regenerative repair models for biodefense. Involves advanced cell engineering, AI-driven drug discovery, and GMP manufacturing for clinical and research applications.

products.name: BioDefense and Toxic Exposure Regenerative Programs
products.description: A national program combining AI and iPSC-derived regenerative cell therapies to diagnose and treat injuries from biological and chemical weapon exposure, including toxic burn pit injuries in veterans. Integrates molecular profiling, AI/ML algorithms, and proprietary cell platforms for precision interventions.

products.name: Sleep Apnea and Respiratory Therapy Devices
products.description: Cloud-connected CPAP, APAP, bilevel, adaptive servo-ventilation, and high flow therapy devices for the treatment of sleep apnea, COPD, and other chronic respiratory diseases. These devices are physically manufactured, require regulated infrastructure, and are delivered through healthcare providers and distributors globally.

products.name: Ventilation Devices
products.description: Invasive and non-invasive ventilators, including life support and non-life support models, for patients with severe respiratory insufficiency or failure. These are complex, regulated medical devices manufactured and distributed for use in home and healthcare settings.

products.name: Mask Systems and Accessories
products.description: A range of nasal, nasal pillows, and full-face masks, headgear, tubing, and related accessories designed for use with sleep and respiratory therapy devices. These are physically manufactured products focused on patient comfort and compliance, distributed through healthcare channels.

products.name: Diagnostic Products for Sleep and Respiratory Disorders
products.description: Portable and cloud-connected diagnostic devices and systems for in-home and clinical diagnosis of sleep apnea and other respiratory conditions. These include devices like ApneaLink Air and NightOwl, and are delivered as physical products with digital integration.

products.name: Cloud-Based Patient Management and Engagement Platforms
products.description: Digital health applications and platforms, such as AirView and myAir, that enable remote monitoring, patient engagement, and therapy management for sleep and respiratory care. These are software-as-a-service solutions delivered digitally to providers and patients.

products.name: Residential Care Software Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software platforms for healthcare providers in residential care settings, including billing, electronic medical records, revenue cycle management, analytics, and workforce management. Delivered as SaaS, these solutions support operational efficiency and compliance for providers such as HME, home health, hospice, and senior living organizations.

products.name: In-Home and Remote Diagnostic Testing Services
products.description: Software-enabled independent diagnostic testing facility (IDTF) services, including in-home and remote testing for sleep, respiratory, cardiac, and other health conditions, primarily in the U.S. These services are delivered through a combination of technology platforms and clinical interpretation.

products.name: Coal Royalty Interests
products.description: Leasing of coal mineral rights to third-party operators, who extract and sell coal (both metallurgical and thermal), with the company earning royalties based on production and sales. The company does not mine coal itself but owns and manages a large portfolio of coal properties across multiple U.S. basins.

products.name: Coal Transportation and Processing Services
products.description: Ownership and leasing of coal transportation and processing infrastructure (such as loadout facilities and preparation plants) to coal mine operators, generating revenue through throughput fees or rents. The company does not operate these facilities directly but subcontracts operations to lessees.

products.name: Oil and Gas Royalty Interests
products.description: Leasing of oil and gas mineral rights to third-party operators, who extract and sell oil and gas, with the company earning royalties based on production and sales. The company does not operate wells itself.

products.name: Industrial Minerals and Aggregates Royalty Interests
products.description: Leasing of mineral rights for industrial minerals (such as limestone, frac sand, copper, lead, zinc) and construction aggregates to third-party operators, with the company earning royalties based on production and sales. The company does not extract these minerals itself.

products.name: Carbon Neutral and Renewable Energy Leasing
products.description: Leasing of land and subsurface rights for carbon sequestration projects, carbon offset credit generation, and renewable energy development (geothermal, solar, wind) to third-party operators, with the company earning royalties or fees. The company does not develop or operate these projects itself.

products.name: Soda Ash Production (via Equity Interest)
products.description: Non-controlling equity interest (49%) in Sisecam Wyoming LLC, which mines trona ore and processes it into soda ash for sale to domestic and international customers in the glass, chemicals, detergents, and related industries. The company does not operate the mine or plant but receives cash distributions based on its ownership.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate loans, multi-family property loans, commercial and industrial loans, construction loans, and land acquisition and development loans. These loans are originated and serviced through both branch and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans including existing single-family residential mortgages, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), custom construction loans, consumer lot loans, student loans, personal lines of credit, and credit cards. These are delivered through branch and digital channels, with underwriting and servicing requiring regulatory compliance and risk management.

products.name: Depository Services
products.description: Accepts deposits from consumers and businesses, including checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. These services are delivered through a network of physical branches and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides a full line of individual and business insurance policies through its subsidiary, WaFd Insurance Group, Inc. These services are offered to both bank customers and the general public, requiring licensed agents and compliance with insurance regulations.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers personalized financial guidance and investment services through WaFd Wealth, Inc. These services include investment advisory and wealth planning, delivered by licensed professionals and requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Sample Management Solutions
products.description: End-to-end sample management products and services including automated storage systems, cryogenic systems, sample repository services, consumables, instruments, controlled rate thawing devices, and informatics software. These solutions require physical manufacturing, regulated infrastructure, and digital software, and are delivered through both products and managed services.

products.name: Genomic and Multiomics Services
products.description: Comprehensive laboratory services including gene sequencing, gene synthesis, bioinformatics, and related sample analysis for research and development in life sciences. Services are delivered digitally and physically via laboratory infrastructure and expert consultation, supporting both standard and custom projects.

products.name: ZORYVE (roflumilast) Topical Treatments
products.description: A line of topical treatments (cream and foam formulations) containing roflumilast, a highly potent and selective PDE4 inhibitor, for chronic use in dermatological diseases such as plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis, and scalp and body psoriasis. These products are manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers and delivered as once-daily, steroid-free creams or foams for direct application to affected skin areas.

products.name: ARQ-234 (CD200R Agonist Biologic)
products.description: An investigational biologic fusion protein that acts as a potent and highly selective checkpoint agonist of the CD200 Receptor (CD200R), intended for the treatment of atopic dermatitis and potentially other inflammatory conditions. The product is in clinical development and, if approved, would be manufactured using biologic production methods and delivered as a systemic therapy.

products.name: Full-Service Restaurant Dining
products.description: Operation of full-service restaurants offering a broad, varied menu including deep-dish pizza, slow-roasted entrees, wings, EnLIGHTened Entrees®, and desserts, prepared to order in physical restaurant locations with in-person service and hospitality.

products.name: Takeout, Delivery, and Off-Premise Meal Services
products.description: Preparation and sale of menu items for takeout, delivery, curbside pickup, and catering, leveraging digital ordering platforms and third-party delivery partners to deliver food and beverages to customers outside the restaurant.

products.name: Proprietary Craft Beer and Flavored Malt Beverages
products.description: Production and sale of proprietary craft beers and flavored malt beverages, brewed in-house at select locations and by third-party brewers, served on-premise and, where permitted, sold for takeout in cans or growlers.

products.name: Bar and Alcoholic Beverage Services
products.description: Provision of a full bar with a selection of domestic, imported, and guest craft beers, wines, and innovative cocktails, served in-restaurant and, where permitted, through takeout and delivery channels.

products.name: BJ’s Brewhouse Beer Club Subscription
products.description: Subscription-based beer club offering members access to special and unique BJ’s beers and exclusive perks, available primarily in California, managed digitally and fulfilled through restaurant visits.

products.name: Catering Services
products.description: Preparation and delivery of large-format meals and bundles designed for groups, families, and events, available for off-premise consumption and ordered via digital or direct channels.

products.name: Proprietary Non-Alcoholic Craft Sodas
products.description: Production and sale of proprietary non-alcoholic craft sodas in various flavors, manufactured in-house and served in restaurants as part of the beverage menu.
